text:
marie_sales: FYI Helio POC blocked by IdP cert rotate -> SAML failures. Need safe onboarding fallback so trial users can continue.

leo_se: Seen the SAML invalid_audience + intermittent SCIM 429. Short-term: surface invite-by-email (viewer only) + SCIM retry worker with exponential backoff. No admin creation.

anya_sec: Must be least-privilege. Invite tokens one-time, signed, TTL <=24h. Redact emails in logs and store hashes. For hosted invites Legal needs DPA note.

jorge_ops: Plan: feature flag sso_onboard_fallback -> show invite CTA on SAML failure; POST /api/tenants/:t/invite {role:viewer,expires:86400}; worker retries 4x (2s base). For Dedicated we provide local invite-generator script.

marie_sales: Pricing question: will invites/retries be charged? leo_se: propose waiving first 500 invites for POC; need finance/legal signed note.

anya_sec: Legal ok to waive with written approval. Require encrypted logs retained 90d and KMS-backed signing (customer KMS for Dedicated).

ops-bot: ops-bot: Rollout queued: feature flag sso_onboard_fallback -> canary 10% ci/9012

marie_sales: Owners: leo -> runbook + SE snippet; jorge -> flag + dedicated script; anya -> loop Legal. ETA 18h.
